name: Deflection, Mass
body:
School abjuration; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, paladin 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets One creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as deflection except it has a longer range and it affects multiple allies.
